text: Iteration 33 (cloud session): build SimForge v6 (sensor model w/ physical units, multi-resonance transmission path, non-Gaussian burst noise, per-impact bearing slip jitter, in-record speed ramps, load-varying VFD lines), regenerate corpus features at deployment condition, retrain fault/severity heads, and evaluate BLIND end-to-end on GitHub-reachable real data (CWRU, MFPT, SEU, wind turbine) against frozen v5 and a classical baseline B1 (kurtogram+envelope at nameplate speed). MAFAULDA remains local-session priority one.

Sim-vs-real discriminator (windowed fs-invariant spectral/envelope features, GBM, healthy-vs-healthy): AUC(v6 vs real) <= AUC(v5 vs real) - 0.05 absolute, on the same real windows. Verdict from experiments/simgap/findings.json only.

Blind end-to-end (analyze_record only, no oracle speed anywhere): v6-trained cascade bearing recall on CWRU+MFPT dev-real >= v5 cascade, AND false bearing calls on healthy/normal records <= v5. Wilson 95% CIs reported; N<30 auto-labeled ANECDOTE.

Classical baseline B1 (SK/kurtogram band selection + envelope spectrum peak test at nameplate-derived defect orders, noise-floor significance) implemented with matched false-positive gate and run on the same dev-real records. The v5-vs-B1 and v6-vs-B1 comparisons are reported whichever way they fall.
